name: Amamiya Yuuzen
source:
With a fun and elegant personality, she is too simple and easy to be confused, but also has a tough side.
Her sense of existence is very weak and often neglected.
The person she likes is called Hanya Suehiro. Her hobby is watching mushrooms.
